objective: Independently audit the sealed M412 Design Compiler evidence for the separately synthesized M405 selected slice and current q32/640-byte M384 controller, including exact identity, tool completion, numerical QoR, constraint/structure cleanliness, artifact completeness, timing robustness and claim boundaries. Do not rerun DC or modify any M412 input/output.
required_checks: Verify every M412 input SHA and both levels of the 47-entry M412 evidence seal.
Verify the M405R3/M407/M410R2/M411 upstream receipts and seals named by the M412 contract.
Verify both dc.rc values, normal Thank-you exits, and absence of anchored Error/Fatal plus ELAB-312/TIM-209/OPT-150 diagnostics.
Independently parse area, cell count, sequential cells, logic levels, worst setup slack and worst hold slack from primary reports.
Verify max/min delay, max capacitance, max transition and max fanout are clean for each cut.
Verify no unresolved references, inferred latches, black boxes or timing loops and audit non-fatal warning residue separately.
Verify mapped Verilog, mapped SDC, DDC and SVF artifacts are nonempty for each cut.
Verify M384 source identity is the current q32/640-byte layout with 32 centers, bases 6240/38912 and 640-byte stride; reject old 576-byte evidence.
Classify the selected-slice 0.8 ps setup margin independently for Formality, diagnostic PrimeTime and publication-grade 3 ns timing.
Preserve separate-synthesis, macro-zero, no-power, no-system-speedup and no-headline boundaries, and verify docs/359 is unchanged.

severity_policy.P0: Invalid identity, corrupted evidence, failed synthesis or functional/claim-integrity blocker.
severity_policy.P1: Must be resolved before the affected result can be promoted to publication-grade PPA or an admitted 3 ns implementation point; may be nonblocking for equivalence or diagnostic downstream work.
severity_policy.P2: Bounded limitation, warning debt or explicit scope boundary that must remain documented but does not invalidate the sealed M412 logic-only result.
